set.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes with a test that finds the fakes-only rule, naming Rex, agents and gh, in the expanded check-compliance, check-quality and check-model topics, finds in check-qa that qa is hands-on with the built binary and that fakes alone do not count, finds no scope check named, and that each topic stays within TopicCap
set.statement: The check-compliance, check-quality and check-model topics tell their checks to test runs with fakes only, never real Rex, agents or gh; check-qa runs the built binary hands-on, since fakes alone do not count for it

set.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... asserts the expanded fixer, ci-fix, gate-fix and conflict-fix topics each name rhiza ship generate, rhiza render and the Checks: block; go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... asserts the review.toml fixer prompt names the fixer topic and ship-change.toml's ci-fix, gate-fix and conflict-fix prompts name the ci-fix, gate-fix and conflict-fix topics.
set.statement: The fixer, ci-fix, gate-fix and conflict-fix topics tell a fixer to run the commands that reproduce its findings, then rhiza ship generate and rhiza render, before its one commit, and to list each command with its exit code in a Checks: block of the commit body; the review workflow fixer prompt and the builtin ship-change workflow ci-fix, gate-fix and conflict-fix prompts reach them by naming their topic.
